note: Sir Jesse Boot's household at St Helier, Clumber Road East (#402) on the 1911 census — thirteen people, none of whom were in the record at all. Each census entry is filed to #402 directly, and everyone is linked to the house as a resident. Occupations are given as the return has them, with the census wording kept in the source line where it differs from the plain form. Birth years come from the ages on the night, except for Jesse and Florence: the 1921 return states theirs outright as 1850 and 1863, which is better evidence than arithmetic from an age, so those are used here. The importer fills blanks only, so whichever file runs first sets them.
source: 1911 census, St Helier, Clumber Road East — transcribed by A. Hagues. The 1929 barony from the same, given with the table.

people.title: Sir
people.bio: Sir Jesse Boot, managing director of Boots, was living at St Helier, Clumber Road East, on the 1911 census with his wife Florence, their three grown children and seven servants. In 1929 he and Florence were elevated to Baron and Lady Trent.
